blocks.title: Condensation polymerisation
blocks.text: Condensation polymerisation mein monomers aapas mein jurte hain aur har naya bond bante waqt aik chhota molecule nikalta hai, aam taur par paani lekin kabhi HCl, CH3OH ya NH3. Monomers mein kam az kam do reactive functional groups (jaise -OH, -COOH ya -NH2) hone chahiye, monomer(s) ke mukhtalif siron par, aur polymer qadam ba qadam barhta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: do qism ke monomer, H-X-H aur HO-Y-OH. Beech: monomers baari baari qatar mein, un ke darmiyan H+HO aur OH+H dabbon mein, yani nikalne wale hisse. Neeche: H-X-Y-X-Y-OH + 3H2O.
blocks.caption: Condensation polymerisation ka tasawwur (Figure 26.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har monomer ke dono siron par reactive group hai. Jahan do monomers milte hain, aik ka H aur doosre ka OH paani ban kar nikalte aur naya bond monomers ko jorta hai, is liye chaar monomers se zanjeer aur paani ke teen molecules bante hain.

blocks.text: Polyesters ki reerh mein ester links (-CO-O-) hote hain. Aik diol (do -OH groups) aur aik dicarboxylic acid (do -COOH groups) mil kar polyester banate hain: diol ka -OH tezaab ke -COOH se react karta aur paani nikalta hai. Terylene (PET) ethane-1,2-diol aur benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid se banta hai.

blocks.alt: Ethane-1,2-diol, HOCH2CH2OH, + benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid, HOOC-C6H4-COOH; diol ka H aur tezaab ka -OH paani ban kar nikalte, PET ka bracket wala repeat unit -O-CH2CH2-O-CO-C6H4-CO- banta, ester links se jura.
blocks.caption: Polyester PET banana (kitab ke khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har ester link diol ke aik sire aur diacid ke aik sire ke darmiyan, paani ka aik molecule kho kar, banta hai. Kyunke dono monomers ke do reactive sire hain, zanjeer dono simton mein barhti reh sakti hai.

blocks.text: Polyesters ki tanao ki taqat zyada hai, jo inhein reshon ke liye munasib banati hai; polyester kam qeemat aur silwat na parne ki wajah se cotton ke mutabadil ke taur par use hota hai. Yeh plastic ke taur par bhi use hota hai, maslan mashroobat aur khurak ki packaging ki PET (PETE) botlein, aur sakht plastics mein cross-links ke taur par, jaise glass fibre se mazboot cross-linked polyester.

items: Diamine aur dicarboxylic acid se: diamine ka -NH2 tezaab ke -COOH se react karta aur paani nikalta hai: n H2N-R-NH2 + n HOOC-R'-COOH -> [-HN-R-NH-CO-R'-CO-]n + n H2O. Nylon-6,6 hexane-1,6-diamine (hexamethylenediamine) aur hexanedioic (adipic) acid use karta hai.
Diamine aur dioyl chloride (do -COCl groups) se, jo dicarboxylic acids se zyada reactive hain; hydrogen chloride nikalta hai: n H2N-R-NH2 + n ClOC-R'-COCl -> [-HN-R-NH-CO-R'-CO-]n + n HCl.

Amino acid se, aik hi monomer jis mein -NH2 aur -COOH dono: aik molecule ka -NH2 doosre ke -COOH se react kar ke paani nikalta aur peptide bond, aik qism ka amide link, banata hai: n H2N-CH2-COOH -> [-HN-CH2-CO-]n + n H2O. Proteins amino acids se bane qudrati polyamides hain (Chapter 27).

blocks.text: Amide links acyl chloride aur ammonia ya amine (jaise methanamine, CH3NH2, ya N-methylmethanamine, (CH3)2NH) ke darmiyan bhi, hydrogen chloride kho kar, bante hain: R-COCl + R'-NH2 -> R-CO-NH-R' + HCl. Yeh kamre ke darja hararat par aasani se hota hai kyunke acyl chlorides bohat reactive hain.

blocks.alt: Aam mua'adlat ke chaar panel: diamine + dicarboxylic acid se polyamide aur paani; diamine + dioyl chloride se polyamide aur HCl; amino acid se polyamide aur paani; acyl chloride + amine se amide R-CO-NH-R' aur HCl.
blocks.caption: Polyamides aur amide links banane ke tareeqe (kitab ke mua'adlon ka asal khulasa).
blocks.long_description: Har soorat mein -NH2 group aur carbonyl group (-COOH ya -COCl se) jur kar amide link, -CO-NH-, banate aur chhota molecule, paani ya HCl, nikalta hai. Kitab monomers ko reactive groups ke darmiyan aik CH2 group ke saath likhti hai; asal monomers, jaise nylon-6,6 ke, ki zanjeerein lambi hain.

blocks.prompt: Diamine aur dioyl chloride ke reaction mein kaun sa chhota molecule nikalta hai, aur dioyl chloride kyun use hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen chloride; dioyl chlorides dicarboxylic acids se kaheen zyada reactive hain, is liye reaction kamre ke darje par aasani se hota hai.

items: Condensation: har jor par chhota molecule (H2O, HCl) nikalta; monomers ko do reactive groups chahiye.
Polyamides (-CONH-): diamine + diacid ya dioyl chloride, ya amino acids.
